services.title: Configure Nodarion
services.description: Choose a section. Changes are applied only after Save & finish.

reconfigure.title: Configure Nodarion
reconfigure.description: Choose a section. Changes are applied only after Save & finish.

reauth_confirm.title: Configure Nodarion
reauth_confirm.description: Choose a section. Changes are applied only after Save & finish.

user.title: Networks & scanning
user.description: Set the initial network, scan interval and exclusions. Additional networks and VLANs are still managed in the Nodarion panel.

network.title: Networks & scanning
network.description: Set the initial network, scan interval and exclusions. Additional networks and VLANs are still managed in the Nodarion panel.

fritz.title: FRITZ!Box & Mesh
fritz.description: Optional: Identify devices through FRITZ!Box and Mesh connections. The connection is tested when detection is enabled.

adguard.title: AdGuard Home
adguard.description: Optional: Add DNS activity and filtering data. The connection is tested when analysis is enabled.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.description: Adjust connection checks and offline detection. Existing defaults are preserved.

data.offline_after: Report as offline after failed scans
data.remove_after_days: Remove offline devices after days (0 = never)

ai.title: AI analysis
ai.description: Optional: Schedule daily AI analysis using the AI Task integration configured in Home Assistant. Anonymized mode excludes domain names; domains mode includes visited domains. These settings are shared with the Nodarion panel.

finish.title: Save & finish
finish.description: All enabled local services are tested again before changes are saved. Closing the dialog discards your changes.
